description: Generate JSON-LD structured data for a website. Detects the site's name, logo, social profiles, contact info, and article metadata, then produces Organization, WebSite, and (when applicable) Article schemas plus starter templates for BreadcrumbList and FAQPage. Returns each schema as a <script type="application/ld+json"> block ready to paste into the site's <head>. Requires an API key.

url.description: The website to generate schema for.

name: generate_schema
title: Generate JSON-LD Schema
